reconciliation.fabrication_control: Every row of the ISD table is either mapped to an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or listed in unmapped_entries with a stated reason; the builder aborts on any label it cannot account for, so no entry exists that the source does not.

volatility.issue: Determination is time-limited, not a standing rule.
volatility.detail: ISD records the row as visa-required because Ireland has temporarily suspended the European Agreement on the Abolition of Visas for Refugees. The page states the suspension runs 'as of 12 noon on 19 July' 'for a period of 12 months' but names no year. The Department of Justice press release linked from the ISD page records the suspension as introduced in July 2022 and extended on a rolling 12-month review basis since, so the current window's end date cannot be derived from the saved source text.
volatility.action_required: Re-verify against the ISD page before relying on this row; do not persist it as permanent and do not infer an expiry date.
